arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Rice argued that premature notices of appeal take effect when the appeal clock starts.
Ms. Brown argued that Section 2107 does not preclude premature notices of appeal.
Mr. Huston argued that Section 2107(c) clearly requires timely filing of notices of appeal.
Justice Jackson questioned whether the notice of appeal was actually premature in this context.

paragraphs: This case determines the procedural validity of early-filed notices of appeal. It clarifies the interaction between statutory deadlines and appellate practice. The outcome affects how courts manage reopened appeal periods.
